project.name: TurnFlow Home
project.notes: Audited the root app at b45b1ac (application code identical to 6a86af5; later commits only add audit-system/). Shell, git history, and GitHub issue access were available. The app could not be started: no Neon database or Docker daemon was reachable, so the Bruno collection is parse-verified but not executed. Unit tests and coverage were run.

planned.text: Primary persona is the self-managing homeowner; vendor and collaborator are request-scoped secondary roles.
Six jobs-to-be-done define the backbone: capture once, compare prices, share one repair, prove the work, keep history, get reminders.
Core loop: request -> invite one vendor/helper -> bid -> approve -> work sessions -> closeout -> billing record -> property history.
Per-role requirements with a 'done when' statement and decision-log event for each.
Password reset is the next planned story.
Out of scope by choice: PMC dispatch, payment processing, open vendor marketplace.
POC success is judged by moderated homeowner sessions against time and proof targets.

built.text: Owner signup and role-routed, rate-limited login.
Guided onboarding, properties, and request intake with photos.
Request-scoped invites with signup-from-invite, resend, cancel, and access removal.
Vendor bids, owner quotes, and approve/decline.
Phased tasks, work sessions with proof, and a status policy.
Closeout submission and owner review that generates a billing record.
History and care: decision log, proof packet PDF, vault, backup/restore, reminders with a daily digest.
Workspace plan and billing-account tables exist without any user-facing story.

gaps.text: Password reset is planned as the next story but not built, so a tester who forgets their password has no way back in.
The backbone has never been validated with real homeowners: 0 moderated sessions logged and the POC success targets are not measured.
Workspace plan and billing-account tables (plans, trials, subscription ids) map to no story while payments are out of scope, adding schema to maintain with no user value yet.

## Notes for building the FigJam board

- Use 7 yellow activity stickies (Join → Keep history and maintain). Put vendor and collaborator tasks on separate swim lanes under "Share and get quotes", "Get the work done", and "Close out and record".

figjam.notes: Story map reconstructed from docs plus 15 pages and 44 server actions. The repo's own requirement matrix is unusually complete; the gaps are about recovery, validation with users, and orphan scope.

planned.text: Documented ERD of the core entities with delete behavior and status enums.
Cross-cutting rules X1-X6: ownership re-check, append-only decision log, scoped helpers, server-decided paths, email never breaks a flow, no payments.
Route-level contracts for the operational and API endpoints.
Atomic multi-write actions and archive-instead-of-delete with an insert-only log (P2).
Only one approved quote per request (auto-decline the rest, F11).

built.text: 21 Drizzle tables, 17 Postgres enums, 50 foreign-key relationships; migrations consistent with the schema.
7 HTTP route handlers sharing a consistent { error } JSON envelope.
44 server actions; zod only in auth and invite forms, hand-written checks elsewhere; 61 return { error } and 21 throw.
Multi-write actions run without transactions on the neon-http driver.
Decision log cascades on request delete, and requests are hard-deleted.
Quote approval checks neither the quote's status nor other approved quotes.

gaps.text: Multi-write actions are not atomic (neon-http, no db.transaction): quote approval and closeout review can half-apply, e.g. a closeout approved with no billing record or a request left in the wrong status.
The decision log is deleted with its request (ON DELETE CASCADE plus hard delete), breaking the product's permanent-history promise.
Several quotes can be approved for one request because approval neither checks status nor declines the others, so the quoted cost record can contradict itself.
A closeout can be reviewed again after a decision (no pending check), so an approved closeout can become changes_requested while the request stays Complete.

Server actions have no single input/result contract: hand-parsed FormData, 21 throwing actions next to 61 returning { error }, and a restore action with no top-level shape check, so failures surface inconsistently.
The endpoint contract map omits /api/files and /api/cron/reset-investor-demo, so 2 of 7 route handlers have no written contract.

# TurnFlow Home: API payload contracts (as built @ b45b1ac)

TurnFlow has **two API surfaces**:

1. **7 HTTP route handlers** under `app/api/`. These are real HTTP contracts and are testable with Bruno.
2. **44 Server Actions** under `lib/actions/`. These are RPC calls that Next.js serializes. They're the main write API, but they aren't stable HTTP endpoints (the action id changes per build), so they're tested by calling them in-process (authorization matrix) or through the UI (Playwright).

Everything below comes from the code. Items marked **PROPOSED** are recommendations, not current behavior.

## Error envelopes in use

| Surface | Shape | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| HTTP routes | `{ "error": "<human message>" }` with an HTTP status | `app/api/files/route.ts:17-19`, `app/api/blob-upload/route.ts:51-54` |
| Server actions, style A (61 sites) | returns `{ error: string }` (or a form state with `error`) | `lib/actions/invites.ts`, `lib/actions/closeout-submissions.ts:121-145` |
| Server actions, style B (21 sites) | `throw new Error("...")`. Reaches the client as a generic error, and there's no `error.tsx` to catch it | `lib/actions/quotes.ts:26`, `lib/actions/requests.ts:219`, `missing:app/error.tsx` |
| Server actions, style C | `redirect()` from `requireRole` when the role is wrong or the user is signed out | `lib/auth/dal.ts:25-30` |

**PROPOSED** single contract: every action returns `{ ok: true, data } | { ok: false, code, message, fieldErrors? }`. Codes: `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `CONFLICT`, `INTERNAL`. Inputs are parsed with zod at the top of each action.

## HTTP route handlers

```text
GET /api/health                       Auth: none                                   @ app/api/health/route.ts:6
  Request   none                                           validated by: n/a
  200       buildHealthPayload()  (public status, no secrets)    Cache-Control: no-store   @ lib/health.ts

GET /api/health/deep                  Auth: Bearer HEALTHCHECK_SECRET               @ app/api/health/deep/route.ts:17
  Request   header Authorization: Bearer <secret>          validated by: lib/health.ts (authorizeDeepHealth)
  200       { status: "ok", auth: "ok", database: "ok", operational: [...], latencyMs }
  401|503   { status: "unauthorized" | "not_configured", auth }       (503 when secret not configured)
  503       { status: "degraded", database: "ok"|"error", operational, latencyMs }
  Notes     raw infrastructure errors are never returned

GET|POST /api/auth/[...nextauth]      Auth.js v5 runtime                            @ app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts:1, lib/auth/config.ts:18-88
  GET  /api/auth/csrf                 200 { csrfToken }
  GET  /api/auth/session              200 { user: { id, email, name, role }, expires } | {} when signed out
  POST /api/auth/callback/credentials form-urlencoded: csrfToken, email, password (+ json=true for a JSON reply)
                                      validated by: zod credentialsSchema   @ lib/auth/config.ts:13-16
           success -> Set-Cookie session (JWT strategy), role baked into token   @ lib/auth/config.ts:73-79
           failure -> no session (wrong password, unknown email, and rate-limited all look the same)  @ lib/auth/config.ts:36-60
  Notes     rate limits: per email + per IP, counted in auth_attempts    @ lib/auth/rate-limit-policy.ts
            rate limiter FAILS OPEN when the DB check errors             @ lib/auth/rate-limit.ts:34-36

POST /api/blob-upload                 Auth: session (owner, or assigned vendor for request paths)   @ app/api/blob-upload/route.ts:45
  Request   multipart/form-data: file (File), pathname (string)
            pathname: turnflow/{requestId}/{type}/{uid}/... | turnflow-property/{propertyId}/{uid}/...
            validated by: content-type allowlist :27-33, 4 MB cap :39, parseUploadPath + ownership :99-129
  200       { url: "/api/files?path=<pathname>", pathname }
  400       { error: "Malformed upload request." | "Upload request is missing the file or its target path." }
  403       { error: "Not signed in" | "Not authorized to upload to this path" | "Unknown upload folder" | ... }
  413       { error: "This file is too large to upload here (limit ~4 MB)..." }
  415       { error: "Unsupported file type: <type>" }
  502       { error: "File storage rejected the upload. Try again shortly." }
  503       { error: "File uploads are not configured on the server." }
  Notes     random suffix makes blob names unguessable (:134). Order of checks: token -> form -> type -> size -> auth

GET /api/files?path=<pathname>        Auth: session + canReadUpload                 @ app/api/files/route.ts:21
  200       file stream, Content-Type from blob, Cache-Control: private, no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  400       { error: "Unknown file." }
  401       { error: "Sign in to view this file." }
  404       { error: "File not found." }   (same answer for missing and not-yours, so paths can't be probed)
  502       { error: "File storage could not return this file." }
  503       { error: "File storage is not configured on the server." }
  Notes     NOT listed in docs/ENDPOINT_EXPERIENCE_MAP.md (GAP-ERASER-06)

GET /api/cron/reminder-digest         Auth: Bearer CRON_SECRET (Vercel Cron)        @ app/api/cron/reminder-digest/route.ts:17
  200       { ownersNotified: number, remindersConsidered: number }
  401       { error: "Unauthorized" }
  503       { error: "CRON_SECRET is not configured" }   (production only)    @ lib/cron-auth.ts:12-25
  Notes     idempotent per 72 h cooldown (last_notified_at). No try/catch: a DB error becomes an unlogged 500

GET /api/cron/reset-investor-demo     Auth: Bearer CRON_SECRET                      @ app/api/cron/reset-investor-demo/route.ts:15
  200       { reset: true } | { skipped: true, reason }
  401|503   { error }
  503       { skipped: true, reason: <password problem> }
  500       { error: "Investor demo reset failed" }
  Notes     NOT listed in docs/ENDPOINT_EXPERIENCE_MAP.md (GAP-ERASER-06)
```

## Run it

1. Put the app on a database with the seed loaded (`npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed`). Set `CRON_SECRET` and `HEALTHCHECK_SECRET` in `.env.local`. Run `npm run dev`.
2. In the Bruno app: **Open Collection** → this folder → environment `local` → set the secret values (`seedPassword` = your `SEED_PASSWORD`, `cronSecret` = `CRON_SECRET`, `healthcheckSecret` = `HEALTHCHECK_SECRET`).
3. Right-click the collection → **Run**. Or headless:

```bash
cd audit-system/audits/turnflow-home/03-bruno && npx @usebruno/cli run --env local
```

Folder order matters: `01-public` must run before `02-auth`, because after login the cookie jar is authenticated.

**Verification status:** all 22 `.bru` files parse with `@usebruno/lang` (`bruToJsonV2`). Expected statuses are taken from the handler code cited in `02-eraser/contracts.md`.

| Route | Requests | Not covered (needs data the seed doesn't expose over HTTP) |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/health` | 01-public/01 | none |

## What the user sees today when something unexpected fails (inferred from Next.js defaults)

- **A server action throws** (21 `throw new Error` sites, such as `approveQuoteAction` when the quote isn't found, `lib/actions/quotes.ts:88-90`): the client component's `await` rejects. Without a local `try/catch` or an error boundary, the same generic screen appears.
- **Slow navigation** (Neon cold start): the previous page stays on screen with no progress feedback until the server responds, because no `loading.tsx` exists.

# TurnFlow Home: PROPOSED specs for the missing states

Everything here is **PROPOSED** design work (it doesn't exist yet). Copy follows the product voice in `docs/ENDPOINT_EXPERIENCE_MAP.md:13-29`: say why you're here, what you can safely do, and what happens next.

## 1. Error state (one shared design, 3 variants)

**Frame names in Figma:** `Shell / State=Error`, `Owner / State=Error`, `Helper / State=Error`.

| Element | Spec |
|---|---|
| Chrome | Keep the role's chrome (owner sidebar from `components/OwnerSidebar.tsx`, helper shell from `components/HelperPortalShell.tsx`). The user must still be able to navigate. |
| Heading | "This page didn't load." |
| Body | "Your record is safe. Nothing was changed. This is usually a short connection problem." |
| Primary action | **Try again** (calls Next's `reset()`) |
| Secondary action | Owner: "Back to dashboard" → `/owner/dashboard`. Vendor: "Back to my jobs" → `/vendor`. Collaborator: "Back to shared requests" → `/collaborator`. |
| Diagnostics | Small muted text: "Reference: {error.digest}" so a tester can quote it (and match it in Sentry once GAP-CODE-01 is closed). |
| Never shown | Stack traces, SQL, raw error messages. |

**Global variant** (`app/global-error.tsx`, when the root layout itself fails): the same copy on a bare page with the TurnFlow wordmark only.

**Action-failure toast** (for the 21 throwing server actions until they return `{ error }`): an inline banner above the panel that was acting: "That didn't go through. Nothing was saved. Try again." It disappears on the next successful action.

## 2. Loading state (route level)

| Screen | Skeleton contents (same sizes as the Populated layout) |
|---|---|
| Owner dashboard | Status-filter pill row; 3 request cards (title bar 60%, two meta lines, a status chip block) |
| Request detail | Title + status chip; left column of 4 panel skeletons (Quotes, Tasks, Work sessions, Closeout); right column for decision log (6 lines) |
| Vendor portal | Work-queue snapshot strip (4 counters); 2 job cards with a next-action panel block |
| Collaborator portal | 1 shared-request card with a readiness checklist (5 lines) |
| Properties / Vault / Calendar / Account / Notifications | Page heading + 3 row skeletons |

Rules: gray blocks with `animate-pulse`, `aria-busy="true"` on the container, no spinner-only screens, and keep the chrome visible (put `loading.tsx` inside `app/owner/`, `app/vendor/`, `app/collaborator/` so layouts stay mounted).

## 3. Idle refinement (only one partial cell)

Request detail with zero photos (`components/RequestDetailView.tsx:657`): replace the plain empty text with "No proof yet. Add a **before** photo now so the vendor sees what you saw," plus an **Add photo** button that opens the existing upload control.

## Figma build checklist for these specs

1. Component set `Page state` with property `State = Idle | Loading | Populated | Error` and property `Role = Owner | Vendor | Collaborator`.
2. One frame per key screen × state for the screens in `state-matrix.md` whose Loading or Error cell is "missing" (13 Loading + 15 Error). Reuse the shared Error and Loading components instead of drawing 28 unique frames.
3. Annotate each frame with the file that will implement it (`app/owner/loading.tsx`, `app/owner/error.tsx`, `app/vendor/error.tsx`, `app/collaborator/error.tsx`, `app/global-error.tsx`).

figma.notes: Idle and action-pending states are a strength. The missing layer is route-level Loading and unexpected Error handling.

Seed is deterministic and idempotent (upserts) with 3 personas.
Seed refuses hosted databases without a strong SEED_PASSWORD, and that rule is unit-tested.

# TurnFlow Home: data models, seed, and inspection (step 5)

**Equivalent tool in this repo:** Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit (Drizzle Studio). The app doesn't use Prisma.

| Artifact | What it is |
|---|---|
| `schema.prisma` | Inspection-only Prisma schema equivalent to the 21 Drizzle tables. **Validated with Prisma 7.10.1** (`prisma validate`). Never migrate with it. |
| `seed-authz-personas.ts` | PROPOSED seed additions in the project's own Drizzle style. Passes the repo's `tsc --noEmit` and ESLint as-is. |

## Built state (verified)

| Check | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Models ↔ migrations consistent | `drizzle-kit check`: "Everything's fine" | `cmd:npx drizzle-kit check`, `drizzle/` (13 migrations, 0000–0012) |
| Drift guard in CI | `db:generate` + `git diff --exit-code -- drizzle` inside `npm run verify` | `package.json:25`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:42-43` |
| Seed deterministic | Yes: fixed fixtures, no randomness | `scripts/seed.ts:33-35` |
| Seed idempotent | Yes: upsert by email, address, and title | `scripts/seed.ts:37-60` |
| Seed guarded | Yes: hosted DB needs a non-default `SEED_PASSWORD` of 12+ characters, unit-tested | `lib/seed-guard.ts:13-35`, `__tests__/seed-guard.test.ts` |
| Personas | owner@test.com, vendor@test.com, collaborator@test.com (+ curated investor demo) | `scripts/seed.ts:173-178`, `lib/demo/investor-seed.ts` |
| Faker | Not used (hand-written fixtures). Fine for determinism. | `search:faker` |

## How to inspect the database

**Native (recommended):** run this with `DATABASE_URL` set in `.env.local`, then open the URL it prints:

```bash
npx drizzle-kit studio
```

**Prisma Studio on the same database (optional, read-mostly):**

```bash
mkdir -p tools/prisma-inspect && cp audit-system/audits/turnflow-home/05-prisma/schema.prisma tools/prisma-inspect/
cd tools/prisma-inspect && npm init -y && npm i -D prisma@7
cat > prisma.config.ts <<'EOF'
import "dotenv/config";
import { defineConfig, env } from "prisma/config";
export default defineConfig({ schema: "schema.prisma", datasource: { url: env("DATABASE_URL") } });
EOF
DATABASE_URL="<your Neon URL>" npx prisma studio
```

In Studio, open **Request**. Filter `status = Complete`, then open its `decisionLog` relation. Keep this in mind: deleting a request here deletes its log too (GAP-ERASER-02).

## Persona table (for Gherkin "Given" steps)

| Persona | Exists today? | UI state it reproduces | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| owner@test.com | yes (`scripts/seed.ts:173`) | Populated: one shared request "Kitchen faucet leaking" | Bruno `02-auth`, smoke scripts |
| vendor@test.com | yes (`scripts/seed.ts:174`) | Vendor Populated | smoke scripts |
| collaborator@test.com | yes (`scripts/seed.ts:175-179`) | Collaborator Populated | smoke scripts |
| idle@test.com | **PROPOSED** | every owner Idle state | Figma/Plane Idle scenarios |
| other-owner@test.com | **PROPOSED** | "other owner" row of the authorization matrix | GAP-BRUNO-01 |
| stranger-vendor@test.com | **PROPOSED** | "unassigned vendor" row | GAP-BRUNO-01 |
| busy@test.com | **PROPOSED** | Populated with 25 requests and a 200-char title | dashboard layout and pagination |

Dev password for all of them: your `SEED_PASSWORD` (`password123` only on a localhost database, `lib/seed-guard.ts:9`).

## Reset

There's no single reset command. Neon branches are the practical way: create a branch, `npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed`, and delete the branch afterward. There's no `migrate reset` equivalent in drizzle-kit.

## GAP-PRISMA-04: the local database path in CONTRIBUTING doesn't work as written

- `CONTRIBUTING.md:23-26` says to run `./scripts/dev-local.sh`, which doesn't exist (`missing:scripts/dev-local.sh`, `missing:docker-compose.local.yml`; planned as backlog Task 0.5 at `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md:37-40`).
- The fallback, "run Postgres manually" (`CONTRIBUTING.md:37`), can't work with the current driver. `lib/db/index.ts:2-11` and `scripts/migrate.ts:2-4` use `@neondatabase/serverless` over **HTTP**, which needs a Neon endpoint or a local Neon HTTP proxy in front of plain Postgres (inferred from the driver choice).
- Meanwhile `lib/seed-guard.ts` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:88-94` describe localhost databases as a supported case. So a new contributor (or a CI integration job) currently needs a Neon account to run anything.
- PROPOSED fix: add `docker-compose.local.yml` with `postgres:17` plus a Neon local HTTP proxy, and a `scripts/dev-local.sh` that waits for it, migrates, and seeds.

// Inspection only. The app uses Drizzle ORM (lib/db/schema.ts). Generated from lib/db/schema.ts
// and drizzle/0000..0012 @ b45b1ac so you can browse the same Postgres database in Prisma Studio
// without changing the app's ORM. Never run `prisma migrate` or `prisma db push` with this file.
// Recommended native equivalent: `npx drizzle-kit studio`.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "./generated"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

enum UserRole {
  owner
  vendor
  collaborator

  @@map("user_role")
}

enum RequestStatus {
  Draft
  NeedsQuote  @map("Needs Quote")
  Waiting
  Scheduled
  InProgress  @map("In Progress")
  NeedsReview @map("Needs Review")
  Complete
  Archived

  @@map("request_status")
}

enum PhotoType {
  before
  after
  receipt
  other

  @@map("photo_type")
}

enum QuoteStatus {
  pending
  approved
  declined

  @@map("quote_status")
}

enum InviteRole {
  vendor
  collaborator

  @@map("invite_role")
}

enum InviteStatus {
  pending
  accepted

  @@map("invite_status")
}

enum VaultCategory {
  Receipt
  Warranty
  Manual
  Invoice
  InspectionReport @map("Inspection Report")
  Other

  @@map("vault_category")
}

enum NotificationStatus {
  sent
  failed

  @@map("notification_status")
}

enum WorkSessionEvent {
  started
  paused
  resumed
  stopped

  @@map("work_session_event")
}

enum RequestTaskStatus {
  todo
  in_progress
  blocked
  done

  @@map("request_task_status")
}

enum CloseoutSubmissionStatus {
  pending
  approved
  changes_requested

  @@map("closeout_submission_status")
}

enum BillingRecordStatus {
  recorded
  paid
  disputed
  void

  @@map("billing_record_status")
}

enum WorkspaceKind {
  personal
  household
  business

  @@map("workspace_kind")
}

enum WorkspaceMemberRole {
  owner
  admin
  member
  billing_admin

  @@map("workspace_member_role")
}

enum WorkspaceMemberStatus {
  active
  invited
  removed

  @@map("workspace_member_status")
}

enum WorkspacePlan {
  poc
  homeowner
  team
  enterprise

  @@map("workspace_plan")
}

enum BillingAccountStatus {
  trialing
  active
  past_due
  paused
  canceled

  @@map("billing_account_status")
}

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email        String   @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  passwordHash String   @map("password_hash")
  role         UserRole
  name         String?  @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  ownedWorkspaces          Workspace[]           @relation("WorkspaceOwner")
  memberships              WorkspaceMembership[] @relation("MembershipUser")
  membershipInvitesSent    WorkspaceMembership[] @relation("MembershipInvitedBy")
  properties               Property[]            @relation("PropertyOwner")
  invitesSent              Invite[]              @relation("InviteOwner")
  invitesAccepted          Invite[]              @relation("InviteAcceptedBy")
  ownedRequests            Request[]             @relation("RequestOwner")
  assignedRequests         Request[]             @relation("RequestAssignedVendor")
  collaboratingRequests    Request[]             @relation("RequestCollaborator")
  uploadedPhotos           RequestPhoto[]        @relation("PhotoUploadedBy")
  submittedQuotes          Quote[]               @relation("QuoteSubmittedBy")
  approvedQuotes           Quote[]               @relation("QuoteApprovedBy")
  decisions                DecisionLog[]         @relation("DecisionActor")
  comments                 Comment[]             @relation("CommentAuthor")
  acceptedTasks            RequestTask[]         @relation("TaskAcceptedBy")
  createdTasks             RequestTask[]         @relation("TaskCreatedBy")
  workSessions             WorkSession[]         @relation("WorkSessionVendor")
  closeoutsSubmitted       CloseoutSubmission[]  @relation("CloseoutVendor")
  closeoutsReviewed        CloseoutSubmission[]  @relation("CloseoutReviewedBy")
  billingRecordsOwned      BillingRecord[]       @relation("BillingOwner")
  billingRecordsAsVendor   BillingRecord[]       @relation("BillingVendor")
  vaultDocumentsUploaded   VaultDocument[]       @relation("VaultUploadedBy")
  contacts                 Contact[]             @relation("ContactOwner")
  notifications            NotificationLog[]     @relation("NotificationOwner")
  vendorProfile            VendorProfile?        @relation("VendorProfileUser")

  @@map("users")
}

model Workspace {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  ownerId   String        @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  owner     User          @relation("WorkspaceOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String        @db.VarChar(255)
  slug      String        @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  kind      WorkspaceKind @default(personal)
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt DateTime      @default(now()) @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  memberships    WorkspaceMembership[]
  billingAccount BillingAccount?
  properties     Property[]
  invites        Invite[]
  requests       Request[]
  billingRecords BillingRecord[]

  @@map("workspaces")
}

model WorkspaceMembership {
  id          String                @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId String                @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  workspace   Workspace             @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId      String                @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  user        User                  @relation("MembershipUser", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role        WorkspaceMemberRole   @default(member)
  status      WorkspaceMemberStatus @default(active)
  invitedById String?               @map("invited_by_id") @db.Uuid
  invitedBy   User?                 @relation("MembershipInvitedBy", fields: [invitedById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt   DateTime              @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt   DateTime              @default(now()) @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  @@unique([workspaceId, userId], map: "workspace_memberships_workspace_user_unique")
  @@index([userId], map: "workspace_memberships_user_idx")
  @@map("workspace_memberships")
}

model BillingAccount {
  id                     String               @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId            String               @unique @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  workspace              Workspace            @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan                   WorkspacePlan        @default(poc)
  status                 BillingAccountStatus @default(trialing)
  billingEmail           String?              @map("billing_email") @db.VarChar(255)
  externalCustomerId     String?              @map("external_customer_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  externalSubscriptionId String?              @map("external_subscription_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  trialEndsAt            DateTime?            @map("trial_ends_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  currentPeriodEndsAt    DateTime?            @map("current_period_ends_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  createdAt              DateTime             @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt              DateTime             @default(now()) @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  @@map("billing_accounts")
}

model Property {
  id          String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  ownerId     String     @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  owner       User       @relation("PropertyOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspaceId String?    @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  workspace   Workspace? @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  address     String
  unit        String?    @db.VarChar(100)
  nickname    String?    @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt   DateTime   @default(now()) @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  requests      Request[]
  vaultDocs     VaultDocument[]
  reminders     Reminder[]
  notifications NotificationLog[]

  @@map("properties")
}

model Invite {
  id           String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  ownerId      String       @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  owner        User         @relation("InviteOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspaceId  String?      @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  workspace    Workspace?   @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  // No FK in the database (circular requests<->invites); see GAP-PRISMA-02.
  requestId    String?      @map("request_id") @db.Uuid
  role         InviteRole
  email        String       @db.VarChar(255)
  status       InviteStatus @default(pending)
  createdAt    DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  expiresAt    DateTime     @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  acceptedById String?      @map("accepted_by_id") @db.Uuid
  acceptedBy   User?        @relation("InviteAcceptedBy", fields: [acceptedById], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction)
  acceptedAt   DateTime?    @map("accepted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

  pendingVendorForRequests       Request[] @relation("RequestPendingVendorInvite")
  pendingCollaboratorForRequests Request[] @relation("RequestPendingCollaboratorInvite")

model Request {
  id                          String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  ownerId                     String        @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  owner                       User          @relation("RequestOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  workspaceId                 String?       @map("workspace_id") @db.Uuid
  workspace                   Workspace?    @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  propertyId                  String        @map("property_id") @db.Uuid
  property                    Property      @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title                       String        @db.VarChar(255)
  category                    String        @db.VarChar(100)
  urgency                     String        @db.VarChar(50)
  location                    String?

  accessInstructions          String?       @map("access_instructions")

  collaboratorId              String?       @map("collaborator_id") @db.Uuid
  collaborator                User?         @relation("RequestCollaborator", fields: [collaboratorId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction)
  estimatedCost               Decimal?      @map("estimated_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  quotedCost                  Decimal?      @map("quoted_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  finalCost                   Decimal?      @map("final_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  pendingVendorInviteId       String?       @map("pending_vendor_invite_id") @db.Uuid

  photos         RequestPhoto[]

  comments       Comment[]

  billingRecords BillingRecord[]

model RequestTask {
  id                 String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  requestId          String            @map("request_id") @db.Uuid
  request            Request           @relation(fields: [requestId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title              String            @db.VarChar(255)
  description        String?
  status             RequestTaskStatus @default(todo)
  estimatedCost      Decimal?          @map("estimated_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  finalCost          Decimal?          @map("final_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  acceptedById       String?           @map("accepted_by_id") @db.Uuid
  acceptedBy         User?             @relation("TaskAcceptedBy", fields: [acceptedById], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction)
  acceptedAt         DateTime?         @map("accepted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)

artifacts.content:
# TurnFlow Home: Plane tickets (one per gap, in `topGaps` order)

Suggested Plane setup:
- **Project identifier:** `TURN`.
- **Modules:** Join · Set up my home · Capture a repair · Share and get quotes · Get the work done · Close out and record · Keep history and maintain · Platform.
- **Labels:** `gap`, `figjam`, `eraser`, `bruno`, `figma`, `db`, `plane`, `observability`.
- **Estimates:** 1 point ≈ 1 focused hour.

Personas in Givens come from `05-prisma/README.md`. Personas marked (P) are PROPOSED in `seed-authz-personas.ts`.

---

### 1a. Switch DB access to a transaction-capable driver and add a `withTransaction` helper
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-01   Priority: Urgent   Labels: gap, eraser, db   Module: Platform   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: `lib/db/index.ts:2` uses `drizzle-orm/neon-http`, which can't run interactive transactions (`docs/03-design/constraints.md:13`). No action uses `db.transaction` (`search:transaction`). Add a second client on `drizzle-orm/neon-serverless` (WebSocket Pool) used only for multi-write actions.

```gherkin
Feature: Transactions are available to server actions

  Scenario: A failing write rolls back earlier writes
    Given a test that opens withTransaction and inserts a decision_log row
    When the next statement in the same transaction throws
    Then no decision_log row from that transaction exists

  Scenario: Single-statement reads keep using the HTTP driver
    When the owner dashboard loads
    Then it uses the existing neon-http client
```
- Out of scope: converting every action (1b).

### 1b. Make quote approval and closeout review atomic
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-01   Priority: Urgent   Labels: gap, eraser, db   Module: Close out and record   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: `approveQuoteAction` makes 3 sequential writes (`lib/actions/quotes.ts:93-112`). `reviewCloseoutSubmissionAction` makes up to 5 (`lib/actions/closeout-submissions.ts:147-208`). A failure in the middle half-applies the decision (F5, `docs/07-refinement/findings-and-roadmap.md:17`).

```gherkin
Feature: Owner decisions apply completely or not at all

  Background:
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    And the request "Kitchen faucet leaking" has a pending closeout from "vendor@test.com"

  Scenario: Approval succeeds
    When I approve the closeout
    Then the closeout is "approved"
    And the request is "Complete" with final cost set
    And exactly one billing record exists for that closeout
    And the decision log has one "closeout_approved" entry

  Scenario: Approval fails midway
    Given inserting the billing record will fail
    When I approve the closeout
    Then I see "That didn't go through. Nothing was saved."
    And the closeout is still "pending"
    And the request status is unchanged
    And no "closeout_approved" entry exists
```
- Out of scope: the other multi-write actions (follow-up ticket per action file).

### 2. Keep the decision log when a request is deleted (archive instead of delete)
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-02   Priority: Urgent   Labels: gap, eraser, db   Module: Keep history and maintain   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: `decision_log.request_id` is `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`lib/db/schema.ts:286-291`), and `deleteRequestAction` hard-deletes (`lib/actions/requests.ts:234`). The "permanent history" promise breaks (F8, `docs/03-design/data-model.md:83`).

```gherkin
Feature: Repair history survives removal

  Background:
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    And the request "Kitchen faucet leaking" has 5 decision log entries

  Scenario: Removing a request archives it
    When I remove the request
    Then it no longer appears on my dashboard
    And its status is "Archived"
    And its 5 decision log entries still exist

  Scenario: The log cannot be deleted directly
    When any code runs "DELETE FROM decision_log"
    Then the database rejects it
```
- Out of scope: a UI to restore archived requests.

### 3a. Test database harness for integration tests
- Gap: GAP-BRUNO-01   Priority: High   Labels: gap, bruno   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: there's no integration layer (`docs/06-testing/test-strategy.md:13`, `:23`). Coverage of `lib/actions` is 0% (`cmd:npx vitest run --coverage`). Depends on GAP-PRISMA-04 (a local or branch database the driver can reach).

```gherkin
Feature: Integration tests run against a real database

  Scenario: Fresh seeded database per test run
    Given CI starts Postgres with the Neon HTTP proxy
    When "npm run test:integration" runs
    Then migrations and the seed (including the authorization personas) are applied first
    And each test file runs inside a rolled-back transaction or a truncated schema
```

### 3b. Authorization matrix for quotes, closeout, and requests actions
- Gap: GAP-BRUNO-01   Priority: High   Labels: gap, bruno   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: the planned matrix (`docs/06-testing/test-strategy.md:43-64`). Sketch: `03-bruno/README.md`.

```gherkin
Feature: Only the right actor can call each action

  Scenario Outline: approveQuoteAction by each actor
    Given a pending quote on "Kitchen faucet leaking" owned by "owner@test.com"
    When <actor> calls approveQuoteAction
    Then the result is <result>
    And if denied, the quotes, requests, and decision_log row counts are unchanged

    Examples:
      | actor                      | result  |
      | owner@test.com             | allowed |
      | other-owner@test.com (P)   | denied  |
      | vendor@test.com            | denied  |
      | collaborator@test.com      | denied  |
      | signed out                 | denied  |
```

### 3c. Authorization matrix for the remaining action files
- Gap: GAP-BRUNO-01   Priority: High   Labels: gap, bruno   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: the other 13 files in `lib/actions/` (invites, tasks, work sessions, vault, reminders, backup, ...). Same outline as 3b, one table per action. Done when every exported action has a row.

### 4. Add error boundaries for every portal and the root
- Gap: GAP-FIGMA-01   Priority: High   Labels: gap, figma   Module: Platform   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: no `error.tsx` or `global-error.tsx` anywhere (`missing:app/error.tsx`, `missing:app/global-error.tsx`). 21 server actions throw (`02-eraser/contracts.md`). Spec: `04-figma/missing-state-specs.md` §1.

```gherkin
Feature: Unexpected failures are recoverable

  Scenario: A page fails to load
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    And the database is unreachable
    When I open the dashboard
    Then I see "This page didn't load."
    And I see the owner sidebar
    And I see a "Try again" button and a reference code

  Scenario: Retry recovers
    Given the database is reachable again
    When I click "Try again"
    Then I see my requests
```
- Out of scope: converting thrown action errors into `{ error }` returns (ticket 10).

### 5. Capture server and client errors in Sentry with alerts
- Gap: GAP-CODE-01   Priority: High   Labels: gap, observability   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: planned in `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md:96-97`, not installed (`missing:instrumentation.ts`, `search:@sentry/`). Today errors only reach `console.error` (24 sites). The rate limiter fails open on DB errors and only logs it (`lib/auth/rate-limit.ts:34-36`).

```gherkin
Feature: Production errors reach a human

  Scenario: Unhandled server error is captured
    Given Sentry is configured for environment "preview"
    When a server action throws during approveQuoteAction
    Then a Sentry issue appears with a readable stack trace for lib/actions/quotes.ts
    And it is tagged with the deploy's git SHA as the release

  Scenario: Rate limiter failure is visible
    When the auth_attempts query fails during login
    Then a Sentry event "rate-limit check failed; allowing request" is recorded

  Scenario: No personal data leaves the app
    When an error occurs during sign-in
    Then the Sentry event contains no password, email, or request body
```
- Out of scope: performance tracing beyond the default sample rate.

### 6. Approve exactly one quote per request
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-03   Priority: High   Labels: gap, eraser   Module: Share and get quotes   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: `approveQuoteAction` doesn't check the current status or decline the others (`lib/actions/quotes.ts:81-112`). F11, `docs/07-refinement/findings-and-roadmap.md:23`.

```gherkin
Feature: One approved quote per request

  Background:
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    And the request has pending quotes from "Ace Plumbing" and "Bay Pipes"

  Scenario: Approving one declines the others
    When I approve "Ace Plumbing"
    Then "Ace Plumbing" is approved
    And "Bay Pipes" is declined
    And the decision log records both decisions

  Scenario: A second approval is rejected
    Given "Ace Plumbing" is already approved
    When I try to approve "Bay Pipes"
    Then I see "A quote is already approved for this request."
    And only one quote is approved
```

### 7. Review a closeout only while it is pending
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-04   Priority: High   Labels: gap, eraser   Module: Close out and record   Estimate: 1 pt
- Context: `reviewCloseoutSubmissionAction` never checks `closeout.status` (`lib/actions/closeout-submissions.ts:136-158`). An approved closeout can later get `changes_requested` while the request stays `Complete`.

```gherkin
Feature: A closeout decision is final

  Scenario: Reviewing an already-approved closeout
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    And the closeout for "Kitchen faucet leaking" is approved
    When I request changes on that closeout
    Then I see "This closeout was already reviewed."
    And the closeout stays "approved"
```

### 8. HTTP contract tests for the 7 route handlers in CI
- Gap: GAP-BRUNO-02   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, bruno   Module: Platform   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: no `.bru`, `.http`, or Postman files (`search:**/*.bru`). The collection is generated in `03-bruno/`. Adopt it at `bruno/` and run it in CI after the app boots.

```gherkin
Feature: Route contracts are checked on every PR

  Scenario: Collection passes against a seeded app
    Given the app runs on a freshly seeded database
    When "npx @usebruno/cli run --env ci" runs in bruno/
    Then all 18 requests pass

  Scenario: A contract change fails CI
    Given /api/files returns 403 instead of 404 for someone else's file
    When the collection runs
    Then "Files - someone else's or missing record" fails
```

### 9. Password reset by email
- Gap: GAP-FIGJAM-01   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, figjam   Module: Join   Estimate: 3 pts (split UI vs token logic if larger)
- Context: listed as next in `README.md:46` and P1 in `docs/07-refinement/findings-and-roadmap.md:58`. Not built (`search:reset.?password|forgot`).

```gherkin
Feature: Recover a forgotten password

  Scenario: Reset link works once
    Given "owner@test.com" requested a reset link
    When they open the link within 60 minutes and set a new password
    Then they can log in with the new password
    And the same link no longer works

  Scenario: Unknown emails get the same answer
    When someone requests a reset for "nobody@test.com"
    Then they see "If that email has an account, a link is on its way."
    And no email is sent
```

### 10. One validated input/result contract for server actions
- Gap: GAP-ERASER-05   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, eraser   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts (first 3 action files; repeat per file)
- Context: zod is used only for auth and invite forms (`lib/auth/forms.ts`, `lib/invites/forms.ts`). The rest parse FormData by hand, mixing 21 throws with 61 `{ error }` returns. Restore has no top-level shape check (`lib/actions/backup.ts:99-114`).

```gherkin
Feature: Server actions reject bad input the same way

  Scenario: Invalid amount on a vendor bid
    Given I am signed in as "vendor@test.com"
    When I submit a bid with amount "abc"
    Then the action returns code "VALIDATION_FAILED" with a field error on "amount"
    And nothing is written

  Scenario: Malformed backup file
    Given I am signed in as "owner@test.com"
    When I restore a backup whose "properties" is not a list
    Then I see "This file is not a TurnFlow backup."
    And nothing is imported
```

### 11. Route-level loading states for owner, vendor, and collaborator portals
- Gap: GAP-FIGMA-02   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, figma   Module: Platform   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: no `loading.tsx` anywhere. The only Suspense fallback covers the sidebar (`app/owner/layout.tsx:14-20`). Spec: `04-figma/missing-state-specs.md` §2.

```gherkin
Feature: Navigation shows progress

  Scenario: Slow dashboard load
    Given I am signed in as "busy@test.com" (P)
    And the database responds after 2 seconds
    When I open the dashboard
    Then I see request card skeletons with the sidebar still visible
    And then the 25 requests replace the skeletons
```

### 12. Run the browser smoke loops in CI on preview deploys
- Gap: GAP-CODE-02   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, observability   Module: Platform   Estimate: 3 pts
- Context: 7 Playwright smoke scripts (`package.json:16-22`) need a real DB + Blob and aren't in CI (`docs/06-testing/test-strategy.md:12`). Roadmap P3 (`docs/07-refinement/findings-and-roadmap.md:60`).

```gherkin
Feature: Full role loop runs on every preview

  Scenario: Preview deploy is smoke-tested
    Given a Vercel preview deploy with a seeded Neon branch
    When the "smoke" workflow runs "npm run ux:full-loop"
    Then the owner, vendor, and collaborator loop completes
    And screenshots are uploaded as artifacts if it fails
```

### 13. Run and log three moderated homeowner sessions
- Gap: GAP-FIGJAM-02   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, figjam   Module: Capture a repair   Estimate: 3 pts per session batch
- Context: protocol exists (`docs/USER_TESTING.md`), with 0 sessions logged (`docs/06-testing/test-strategy.md:24`). Success targets are unmeasured (`docs/01-problem/problem.md:52-60`).

```gherkin
Feature: The backbone is validated with real homeowners

  Scenario: Session produces evidence
    Given a tester who manages their own repairs
    When they capture a real repair from scratch
    Then the time from start to a complete request is recorded
    And every "what happens next?" moment is logged as a finding
```

### 14. Make local development work without a Neon account
- Gap: GAP-PRISMA-04   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, db   Module: Platform   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: `CONTRIBUTING.md:26` references a missing `scripts/dev-local.sh`. Plain Postgres can't serve the neon-http driver without a proxy (`lib/db/index.ts:2-11`, inferred). See `05-prisma/README.md`.

```gherkin
Feature: One-command local setup

  Scenario: Fresh clone runs locally
    Given a machine with Docker and no Neon account
    When I run "./scripts/dev-local.sh"
    Then Postgres and the Neon HTTP proxy start
    And migrations and the seed run
    And "npm run dev" serves the dashboard for "owner@test.com"
```

### 15. Move the backlog and open findings into the tracker
- Gap: GAP-PLANE-01   Priority: Medium   Labels: gap, plane   Module: Platform   Estimate: 1 pt
- Context: the backlog asks for one issue per task (`docs/IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG.md:12`). GitHub has 1 issue (`issue:#2`). This file is the import source.

```gherkin
Feature: Every known gap is tracked

  Scenario: Import the audit
    Given the 25 gaps in audit.json
    When the tickets in this file are created in Plane
    Then every gap's ticketRef points to a TURN-n key
    And the "Open gaps" view lists all of them by priority
```

### 16. Add the missing foreign key on invites.request_id
- Gap: GAP-PRISMA-02   Priority: Low   Labels: gap, db   Module: Share and get quotes   Estimate: 1 pt
- Context: no FK, to avoid a circular reference (`lib/db/schema.ts:206-208`). Add it in a follow-up migration (`ON DELETE CASCADE` for pending invites), since both tables exist by then.

```gherkin
Feature: Invites always point at a real request

  Scenario: Deleting a request removes its pending invites
    Given a pending invite for "Kitchen faucet leaking"
    When the request row is removed
    Then the invite row is removed too
```

### 17. Refresh the role in the session (JWT) or verify it per request
- Gap: GAP-CODE-04   Priority: Low   Labels: gap, observability   Module: Join   Estimate: 2 pts
- Context: the role is set once at sign-in (`lib/auth/config.ts:73-79`). F12, `docs/07-refinement/findings-and-roadmap.md:33`.

```gherkin
Feature: Role changes take effect

  Scenario: Deleted user loses access
    Given "vendor@test.com" has a session
    When the account is deleted
    Then the next request from that session is treated as signed out
```

### 18. Index the foreign keys used by every page query
- Gap: GAP-PRISMA-01   Priority: Low   Labels: gap, db   Module: Platform   Estimate: 1 pt

**PROPOSED setup** (Next.js 16): run `npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i nextjs`. Keep the existing `next.config.ts` headers when the wizard wraps it with `withSentryConfig`. Add Sentry's ingest host to `connect-src` in `lib/security-headers.ts` if the CSP blocks it. Set `SENTRY_DSN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN`, and `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` (CI only). Set `sendDefaultPii: false`, and add a `beforeSend` that drops request bodies for `/api/auth/*`.

## 4. Top risks (likelihood × impact, 1–3 each)

| Rank | Risk | L | I | Score | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A production failure (DB timeout, thrown action) goes unnoticed, and the user sees a dead-end error page | 3 | 3 | 9 | GAP-CODE-01, GAP-FIGMA-01 |
| 2 | Approval or closeout half-applies on a mid-sequence failure (e.g. request Complete without a billing record) | 2 | 3 | 6 | GAP-ERASER-01 |
| 3 | An authorization regression in one of 44 server actions ships, because none is tested against a DB | 2 | 3 | 6 | GAP-BRUNO-01 |
| 4 | An owner deletes a request and loses its permanent history | 2 | 3 | 6 | GAP-ERASER-02 |
| 5 | Two quotes approved, or a decided closeout re-reviewed, leaving contradictory cost and status records | 2 | 2 | 4 | GAP-ERASER-03, GAP-ERASER-04 |
| 6 | Rate limiting silently disabled during a DB incident | 1 | 3 | 3 | GAP-CODE-01 |

## CI pipeline (what a bad PR still gets past)

`npm run verify` = lint → typecheck → unit tests → `npm audit --omit=dev` → `drizzle-kit generate` + `git diff --exit-code -- drizzle` → build (`package.json:25`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:42-43`).

A PR can still: break an ownership check in a server action, break any route's HTTP contract, break the end-to-end loop, or drop coverage, and CI stays green.
